subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become a trusted bootstrap source that overrides the agent workspace, or should bootstrap authority remain workspace-only with diagnostics for misplaced files?
rationale: This changes which local directory can inject high-trust system instructions and can activate previously ignored files during upgrades; source inspection cannot determine the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep workspace authoritative
options.body: Retain the existing per-agent workspace contract and warn users when bootstrap-named files are present in `agentDir`.

options.title: Adopt agentDir authority
options.body: Explicitly document and test `agentDir` as a second trusted bootstrap root, including precedence, upgrade, session-filtering, and hook contracts.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Close or pause the competing implementation PRs until one canonical bootstrap-directory design is approved.

recommendation.title: Keep workspace authoritative
recommendation.body: Retain the existing per-agent workspace contract and warn users when bootstrap-named files are present in `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of the bootstrap snapshot path makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the authority decision.
